messages:
micah: opened a PR to clarify streaming behavior for model cards when prefix caching + long prefixes interact with chunked streaming. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123

micah: main ask: (1) a tiny SDK streaming example that shows how to tune the client buffer to avoid mid-token splits, (2) a short note in the model card about fallback variant behavior when kernel splits a token, and (3) fix the anchor that lint flagged.

esther: thanks — tagging runtime and devex. can you paste the lint error and the current snippet you added?

micah: pasted lint output below and the snippet i tried (fails on duplicate-anchor):

lint-bot: ERROR docs/guide/streaming.md: anchor "streaming-behavior" already defined in docs/models/aurora-7b.md line 42.

micah: snippet i added:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
with client.stream(model="aurora-7b", max_buffer_tokens=64) as stream:
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.text, end="")
```

micah: this works for normal cases but we see user reports where the runtime emits a split inside a long UTF-8 sequence on low-memory variants. need to document the safe config.

marco: runtime note: we landed a change where lowmem variants may split on byte boundaries for very long tokens to avoid OOM. recommended wording: "If you use a low-memory variant, set max_buffer_tokens >= 64 and prefer token-based chunking. Expect rare mid-token splits; use the SDK rejoin helper." Also recommend linking to the fallback table in the catalog.

esther: can you propose a 1-2 sentence patch and a tiny snippet for the JS SDK too? i'll add it to the PR and resolve the anchor duplication by moving the model-specific anchor under the model card namespace.

al: i'll take a quick pass on the PR — main thing: mention which variants are affected (aurora-7b-lowmem, aurora-7b-edge). add a compatibility row to the card: "streaming: best-effort; prefer full model if consistent token boundaries required."

sara: i'll port micah's python example to JS. proposed JS snippet:```js
const client = new RedwoodClient();
const stream = await client.stream({ model: 'aurora-7b', max_buffer_tokens: 64 });
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  processChunk(chunk.text);
}
```
docs-bot: preview deployed for PR #5123 — http://deploy-preview.docs/5123 — anchors updated in preview (untagged).

lint-bot: re-run complete: no anchor duplicates in branch-5123. one small markdown lint warning: heading-style in streaming.md (line 10).

micah: great — i've updated the PR with marco's suggested wording and added a tiny FAQ bullet about reassembling split tokens using SDK helper: `client.rejoinStreamChunks(chunks)`. moved anchor into docs/models/aurora-7b.md as suggested.

esther: perfect — i'll merge after al's review and a quick smoke test of the JS snippet in the next hour. thanks everyone :tada:

al: quick review left, nothing blocking. approving now.

micah: thanks all — assigning followups: @sara for JS snippet smoke, @marco to add a line in runtime changelog, @esther to merge after smoke. will close the PR once merged."
